THE FCC CHECK IS QUIETLY BEING SKIPPED. Four wave-7 records have no FCC grant located, each because the manufacturer's own documentation states the radio directly and the agent conserved budget. Every one says so in its open_questions, so nothing is hidden — but VERIFIER calls the FCC check the cheapest disambiguator it has and asks for it before forming an opinion, and it is now routine to skip it whenever a manual mentions Wi-Fi. Either the procedure should say that is fine, or agents should stop doing it. It is currently neither.
